nom: Thayers 2% AHA Exfoliating, Smoothing and Pore Refining Toner

segments.oily: The couple of reviewers with oily skin say it helps control oiliness and leaves skin feeling less greasy without drying it out.
segments.dry: Dry-skin reviewers, including one with dry sensitive skin, generally report it doesn't leave their skin feeling tight or flaky and even softens rough patches, though the one with dry sensitive skin limits use to once a day with moisturizer due to mild redness after application.
segments.combination: Combination-skin reviewers say it's one of the few toners that doesn't dry out their skin, which they had struggled to find before.
segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers are the largest group and overwhelmingly report no burning, stinging or redness, with several specifically noting it's the first acid toner their sensitive skin has tolerated; one dissenting reviewer says it can dry out skin that's too sensitive and recommends spacing out use, and another says it left her face slightly red after application.
segments.mature: A few older reviewers, including one managing perimenopausal skin changes and another focused on the eye and brow area, describe the exfoliating effect as gentle while noticing visible changes in those areas.

concerns.blemishes: Many reviewers report clearer skin and fewer breakouts, in some cases within a few days to two weeks; dissent includes one critical review that noticed no change in blemishes at all, and another who was still somewhat broken out after a week of use.
concerns.spots: A number of reviewers say their skin tone became noticeably more even with regular use, some needing less concealer over time; no reviewer reports increased discoloration.
concerns.redness: Several reviewers say it doesn't cause redness or irritation, with a couple specifically contrasting it with harsher toners that used to leave their skin red; two dissenting reviewers say it left their face slightly red after application or only 'a little less red' rather than redness-free.
concerns.oiliness: The few reviewers who mention oil say it reduces oiliness and greasiness without leaving skin dry.
concerns.dehydration: The large majority of reviewers, including some with dry or combination skin, say it doesn't dry out their skin and several describe it as actively hydrating; dissent includes a couple of reviewers who found it somewhat drying — one recommending it only every few days and another pairing it with extra moisturizer to offset the effect.
concerns.aging: A small number of reviewers mention visible changes around fine-line-prone areas like the eyes and brow, and describe their skin looking more supple, youthful or fresh, though this is only raised by a handful of reviews.

aspects.libelle: Citrus scent noticeable despite fragrance-free labeling
Lifts visible residue left after cleansing
Economical, a little goes a long way
Mild tingling or stinging on first few uses
Budget-friendly compared to other AHA toners

extraits.texte: This did absolutely nothing for me. I was very surprised that it was described as being refreshing when the main ingredient is water. It didn't clean my skin further after washing it, which is what toner is supposed to do. Nor did I notice any difference in my pores,blemishes or the texture of my skin. I won't be purchasing this again.

Generally like this and I've notice a very slight improvement in texture but I use it as part of my night routine because it does make my face slightly red for a bit after application. I have dry sensitive skin so I don't use this more than once a day with moisturizer.

2% Aha toner works great on my skin. A little goes a long way so only a little is needed. Not for too sensitive of skin this can dry out skin somewhat if it does just use your usually moisturizer and it this product only once every few days. Love he ingredients and the product I will buy again for my skincare routine.

This facial toner is my go to every morning and evening! I have combination skin so it is hard to find a good toner that doesn't dry out my skin. I have not noticed my skin to be more dry, it is actually the exact opposite!

This product worlds wonders , my skin tone is evening out and I'm not having to use as much concealer and bronzer , I will continue to use this product cause it works wonders on my skin , I can't wait to see my results in 6 months

I love the this toner and have been using it for awhile, it really helps out with my oily skin. I have used it for other daily routines as well. I have put it on my bug bites and it works well as a repellent too.

I haven't used toner too much as part of my skincare routine, but I'm trying to step up my skincare game. I'm experiencing some hormonal acne now that I'm in my forties and so I take extra special care of my skin nowadays. I use this toner after my shower or when I wash my face in the morning and at night. It says that it's fragrance-free but it definitely has a light citrus fragrance. It leaves my skin feeling so soft and fresh. I can definitely fee the difference.
